title.narrative: Safe Return: Integrated Assistance for the Most Vulnerable Communities

description.narrative: ltpgtThrough the Envelope 2, this project aims to improve access to integrated services for returnees and vulnerable communities in their areas of origin within the underserved areas of Jabal Semaan and Aleppo countryside.ltbrgtThe project will be implemented through 4 MMU in Taduf, Menbij , Jabal Semaan, Atarib, and Darat Azza.ltbrgtThe MMUs provide its services within government clinics after providing the necessary equipment. The project will also encourage the local community to implement project activities through an integrated MMUs (healthprotection) that provides services to the most vulnerable groups, such as working women, PWDs, and the elderly. The teams will be designed as follows:ltbrgt1. Defining roles through team exchanges of information necessary to integrate services while maintaining beneficiary confidentiality and privacy. Medical teams can report any protection-related issues, such as domestic violence or exploitation, and refer victims to the protection team, and vice versa. The protection team can refer any medical needs of beneficiaries to the medical teams.ltbrgt2. All services integrated within the clinics respect human rights, such as maintaining privacy and protecting beneficiaries from violence.ltbrgt3. The protection team will be responsible, in addition to its activities, for selecting and distributing non-food items.ltbrgt4. Training teams on violence.ltbrgt5. Joint referral systems and collaborative needs assessments, where teams can conduct a joint health and protection assessment simultaneously.ltbrgtThe teams will be distributed through the govermental clinics and the villages sournding as:ltbrgt**Team 1: In Tadaf through the governmental Clinics Ex: Aisha and Abu Jabbar**ltbrgt**Team 2: Menbij town through Govermental clinics, Ex: Ousjli Health Center, Tal Houthan Health Center, and Tal Al-Rafi' Health Center, as these three centers form the Menbij City Triangle.ltbrgt**Team 3: Atarib and Darat Izza through govermental clinics** Ex: in Big Ourm and Taqad PHCs.ltbrgt**Team 4: Jabal Semaan Ex: in the "Wadihi and Balas" Medical Govermental Clinics and the villages sournding.ltbrgtFor the Health sector, the project will focus on re-equipment in primary health facilities in return areas to utilize existing public health infrastructure to the maximum extent possible to ensure the continuity and quality of services and to ensure a regular supply of essential medicines for the management of chronic and life-saving diseases.ltbrgtIt will also activate referral networks to connect areas of return with higher-level care , in coordination with local government health facilities and referral services.ltbrgtFor the Protection sector (GPGBV AoRs):ltbrgt1. response services focused on GBV survivors will be provided (case management, psychosocial support for survivors).ltbrgt2. Strengthening the mitigation of GBV risks through the distribution of dignity kits to returnees and skills development for women and adolescent girls.ltbrgt3. General protection (GP AoR) services targeting the most vulnerable returnees and communities in areas of origin through (psychosocial support, referral pathways for survivors of violence, exploitation, or detention, training for frontline staff, providing GIKA in beneficiary areas, and providing community-based psychosocial support).ltbrgt- For NFIs, psychological support workers will distribute winter NFIs to the most affected returnee families and communities in areas of origin suffering from chronic diseases. Receiving this assistance will mitigate the increasing impact of chronic diseases during the winter season.ltbrgtKey results: Sustainability of government health facilities with high adherence to medication treatment among patients with chronic diseases, a significant decrease in domestic violence rates, and increased participation of men in violence prevention activities.ltbrgtInnovative elements of the project: Sustainability of government primary healthcare centers by integrating medical services with protection mechanisms and winter NFI distribution into a single model.ltbrgtlt/pgt
